verdict.rope_metadata_note: print_info 'rope scaling = linear' is GGUF metadata (KV overrides do not apply in that dump); runtime evidence is 'custom YaRN scaling detected, re-adjusting n_ctx_train'.
verdict.assumption_corrected: Expected 131072 to fail on RAM, but a CPU-only server loaded it and answered a 4k-token prompt: the KV cache is lazily committed, so short requests never fill it. This does NOT prove 131072 long-input usability.
verdict.rcfa: A full 131072 context needs ~9.8 GiB KV (q8_0) or ~4.9 GiB (q4_0) PLUS ~4.6 GiB weights; only ~2.7 GiB RAM was free and the 6 GiB GPU is shared with Ollama, so a genuinely filled 131072 context cannot be materialized here. Engine logs still warn 'n_ctx_seq (131072) > n_ctx_train (40960)'. Ollama itself clamps num_ctx to the native 40960 unless YaRN is applied at engine level.
